host: Apple M4 Max, 128 GB unified memory
question: Does SwiftVR restore a single frame acceptably? A one-frame clip is a legal 4a+1 input and completes, so the route is gated on output quality rather than on whether it runs.
method: Each source downscaled to a 256px short edge and JPEG-crushed to quality 32. SwiftVR restored the identical frame as a one-frame video through --video-path at 1x. SeedVR2-3B restored the same PNG through its image route at 1x. Correlation is per-image Pearson on luma against the degraded source.
reading: SwiftVR's one-frame output is visibly degraded on every sample: facial structure collapses and colour desaturates. Correlation does not capture this - SwiftVR scores at or above SeedVR2 on some samples while being clearly worse, which is why the sheet is the evidence and the number is not. Cause: restoring a single frame seeds the causal autoencoder state from a replicated frame instead of real temporal context.
conclusion: SwiftVR's image route stays withheld. Stills route to SeedVR2.
